summary.intent: Optimize IPFS/Kubo infrastructure by implementing concurrent IPNS pin orchestration and migrating to pebbleds datastore for improved write throughput.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 completed: uploadFile now uses Promise.allSettled for parallel IPNS publish and folder metadata update, with 4 tests covering concurrency and partial failure. Wave 2 (pebbleds datastore + baselines) was initiated but required user action due to autonomous:false checkpoint.

repo: Work is organized into numbered waves (e.g., 19.2-01, 19.2-02) with dependency checks between waves
Plans can have autonomous:false checkpoints that pause execution for infrastructure changes requiring user intervention
Docker Compose configurations manage Kubo IPFS node settings including datastore type

code.finding: uploadFile uses Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update, allowing partial failure handling without blocking on either operation

workflow: Pre-wave dependency checks are run before spawning agents for each wave
Promise.allSettled is preferred over Promise.all for concurrent operations where partial failure should be tolerated
Performance optimization work involves capturing before/after baselines for documentation

friction: Wave 2 blocked on user action — infrastructure changes to Docker Compose for pebbleds datastore cannot proceed autonomously
open_items: Wave 2 (19.2-02): pebbleds datastore Docker Compose configuration changes pending user approval/action
Post-optimization baseline capture and before/after comparison documentation not yet completed
